items: The dashboard feels like the app: buttons react, keyboard focus is easy to see, and copy buttons confirm with a check.
Status warns when your browsing history has not been imported for a while, with Import new history now.
Chat lists the sites you visited and sums up a day or week in about a second, even on a big history.
Browser profiles you untick in the history list stay unticked in every automatic import.
Chat understands more dates ("on Monday", "last night", "the last 3 days", "what's due on Friday?") and a day starts at 04:00, as in Today.
Sites filed under a category you set to Don't save never show in Chat's site lists or summaries.
do: Your first browsing import after this update rebuilds every day your browsers still hold, once, so it takes longer than usual.

items: Chat shows what it is doing while an answer is on its way, and how long the answer took.
Esc stops an answer, every answer has Copy, and scrolling up no longer drags you back down.
"Which sites did I visit?" lists every site once, most visited first; name a browser to see only its visits.
New browser history comes in by itself every 6 hours while the app or the receiver runs (Browsing, Past history).
Chat answers "What should I study today?", "what's due?" and "summarize my week" from your own plan and records.
The browser extension only sends its key to your own Cortex receiver, never to another program on that port.
do: Reload the Cortex browser extension: open your browser's Extensions page and click the reload arrow on Cortex.
To keep history coming in without the app open, turn on Start at login under Browsing.
